crew.original_title: Indagine su un cittadino al di sopra di ogni sospetto
crew.overview: Rome, Italy. After committing a heinous crime, a senior police officer exposes evidence incriminating him because his moral commitment prevents him from circumventing the law and the social order it protects.
crew.title: Investigation of a Citizen Above Suspicion

details.biography: Marina Cicogna Mozzoni Volpi di Misurata (29 May 1934 – 4 November 2023) was an Italian film producer and photographer.  She is known for Investigation of a Citizen Above Suspicion (1970), Footprints on the Moon (1975) and The Master Touch (1972).
details.name: Marina Cicogna
